source_refs.note: 4. Public health policy: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-188.

blocks.text: Biostatistics population ki sehat ka data aur sehat ke programmes jaanch kar public health policy banane mein madad deti hai. Yeh kamzor groups aur sehat mein na-barabari (health disparities) pehchanti hai, aur policy banane walon ko saboot deti hai taa ke woh aise iqdamaat karein jo barabari (equity) laayen aur bare paimane par sehat behtar karein.
